full_prompt_en: A square collagraph print on warm off-white paper depicts three large fish overlapping in a compact horizontal arrangement. All three heads point to the right, with one near the top, one partly hidden in the middle, and a darker fish along the bottom. Their bodies extend beyond the left edge of the colored image area, making their circular eyes, open mouths, gill lines, and patterned scales the most legible details. Behind them, a patchwork of rectangular plates in rust orange, copper, slate blue, charcoal, and brown forms a shallow geometric ground. The top fish catches the most copper light; the middle one is more muted olive-gray; the lower one nearly merges with the dark base except for warm highlights across its snout. Their outlines are firm but slightly ragged, as if pressed from inked raised surfaces rather than drawn with a smooth pen. Crosshatched scale marks, rubbed ink, pitted speckles, and scratches cover the fish and background alike. Some plate borders remain visibly misaligned, and layered ink produces darker seams at overlaps. The image is enclosed by a modest blank paper margin with a faintly irregular edge. The composition is dense and frontal, but the alternating light and dark strips allow each head to emerge in turn. Light is implied through the copper and cream ink patches rather than through a realistic scene or a cast shadow. The palette is earthy and restricted, with cool blue-gray areas tempering the strong reddish-orange. The print feels handmade and tactile, balancing recognizable animal forms against an abstract grid of distressed color blocks.
full_prompt_zh: 一幅印在暖灰白纸上的方形拼贴版画，以紧凑横向布局表现三尾相互叠压的大鱼。三者鱼头都朝右：一尾在上，一尾中间部分被遮，一尾较暗的鱼沿底部。身体延伸出彩色图像区域左缘，使圆眼、张口、鳃线与图案化鳞片成为最可辨细节。它们身后，铁锈橙、赤铜、板岩蓝、炭灰与棕色矩形版块组成浅而几何的底面。上方鱼承受最多赤铜亮色；中间一尾偏低调橄榄灰；下方几乎融进暗底，只在嘴吻有暖高光。轮廓坚实却略毛糙，像从上墨凸起表面压出，而非用平滑钢笔绘成。交叉排线鳞纹、擦开的墨、坑点与刮痕同时覆盖鱼和背景。有些版块边界明显错位，层叠印墨在交接处形成更深色接缝。图像被适中的空白纸边围住，纸缘微微不规则。构图密集而正面，但交替明暗色带让各个鱼头依次浮出。光由赤铜和奶油墨片暗示，而非写实场景或投影。配色泥土感且受限，冷蓝灰区域调和强红橙色。版画有手作可触感，在可识别动物形态与磨损色块的抽象网格之间取得平衡。
style_prompt_en: Collagraph printmaking layers raised and recessed textures into a compact field of rectangular color plates. Rust orange, copper, charcoal brown, and slate blue-gray form an earthy restricted palette on visible warm paper. Ink deposits unevenly, leaving pitted grain, rubbed patches, crosshatched mesh, scratches, and dark seams where plates overlap. Recognizable curved contours emerge from the geometry but retain slightly broken, pressure-printed edges. Repeated round marks and parallel incisions give small details a deliberate rhythm amid large distressed blocks. Light is conveyed by pale paper showing through and by warmer ink areas, rather than by smooth volumetric shading. A shallow frontal arrangement stacks several horizontal masses inside a square frame, with alternating light-dark strips preserving separation. The surrounding blank margin and imperfect registration make the surface feel physically handled, tactile, and quietly archival.
style_prompt_zh: 拼贴版画把凸起与凹陷纹理叠入紧凑的矩形色版区域。铁锈橙、赤铜、炭褐与板岩蓝灰在可见暖纸上组成受限泥土调色。油墨着色不均，留下坑状颗粒、擦拭斑块、交叉网纹、刮痕以及版块叠压处的深接缝。可辨的弯曲轮廓从几何中浮出，却保留略断裂的受压印边。重复圆点和并行刻线让小细节在大块磨旧色面间有刻意节奏。亮度由露出的浅纸和较暖墨区传达，而非平滑体积明暗。浅空间正面布局把数道水平体量叠在方框里，交替明暗色带维持分离。周围空白边和不完美套准令表面有经手操作、可触且安静档案般的气质。
theme_en: Three overlapping fish arranged in a textured copper and blue-gray print
theme_zh: 三尾交叠的鱼置于赤铜与蓝灰纹理版画中
name: Collagraph
reuse_rule: Use style_prompt_en/zh for transferable visual style. Full prompts and themes are examples of the original scene, not content to carry into a new user theme.
